Reading in packages and FID data
```{r install}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
require(AICcmodavg);  require(gclus);  require(SASmixed)
if (!requireNamespace("lmerTest", quietly = TRUE)) {install.packages("lmerTest")}
library(Matrix)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyr)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(patchwork)
FID <- read.csv("hare_FID.csv")
```

  Replace blanks with NA, Removing records with NA for FID.
  Classify hare % white and 1 and 10m snow values as numeric, Eartag as factor
```{r NArm_classes}
FID[FID == ''] <- NA
FID[FID == 'n/a'] <- NA
FIDs <- drop_na(FID, FID_m)
FIDs <- drop_na(FID, Eartag)

FID$P_White <- as.numeric(FID$P_White)
class(FID$P_White)
FID$snow_1m <- as.numeric(FID$snow_1m)
class(FID$snow_1m)
FID$snow_10m <- as.numeric(FID$snow_10m)
class(FID$snow_10m)
FID$rep <- as.numeric(FID$rep)
class(FID$rep)
FID$Concealment <-as.numeric(FID$Concealment)
class(FID$Concealment)
FID$conc <- as.numeric((FID$Concealment)*25 - 12.5)
class(FID$conc)
FID$Eartag <- as.factor(FID$Eartag)
class(FID$Eartag)
```

  Create square-root transformed FID variable. Create subsets of data where Concealment values and FID values are all recorded.
```{r data subsets}
#Drop values with NA for FID, eartag, and filter FIDs to those under 20m.
FIDs <- drop_na(FID, FID_m)
FIDs <- drop_na(FID, Eartag)
FIDs <- filter(FIDs, FID_m <= 20)

#Create square-root transformed FID variable and view its distribution
FIDs$FID <- sqrt(FIDs$FID_m)
hist(FIDs$FID)

#Calculate contrast (hare % white - % snow) at 1m and 10m, calculate mismatch as absolute value of contrast
FID$m_contrast <-(FID$P_White - FID$snow_1m)
FID$tenm_contrast <-(FID$P_White - FID$snow_10m)
FIDs$m_contrast <-(FIDs$P_White - FIDs$snow_1m)
FIDs$tenm_contrast <-(FIDs$P_White - FIDs$snow_10m)
FID$mm1m <- abs(FID$m_contrast)
FID$mm10m <- abs(FID$tenm_contrast)
FIDs$mm1m <- abs(FIDs$m_contrast)
FIDs$mm10m <- abs(FIDs$tenm_contrast)

#Creating subsets of data without missing values of relevant variables
FIDcc <- filter(FIDs, WCC!='UNK')          #known color morph for all hares
snoFID <- drop_na(FIDs, snow_1m, snow_10m) #known FID and snow cover
snoFIDcc <- drop_na(FIDcc, snow_1m, snow_10m) #known color morph, FID, and snow cover

Conc <- drop_na(FID, Concealment)           #known concealment
Concc <- filter(Conc, WCC!='UNK')            #known concealment and color morph
snoConc <-drop_na(Conc, snow_1m, snow_10m)   #known concealment and snow cover
snoConcc <- drop_na(Concc, snow_1m, snow_10m) #known color morph, concealment, and snow cover
```

Correlaton matrix
```{r corr}
num_FIDs <- FIDs[, sapply(FIDs, is.numeric)]
num_FIDs <- drop_na(num_FIDs)
cor(num_FIDs)

#another matrix just for white hares (to see correlation between coat whiteness and % snow)
num_wFIDs <- wFIDs[, sapply(wFIDs, is.numeric)]
num_wFIDs <- drop_na(num_wFIDs)
cor(num_wFIDs)
```



      ~____________QUESTION 1____________~
  Do sympatric color morphs differ in their predator avoidance behavior?
  
  H1: Sympatric color morphs differ in their predator avoidance behavior.
      P1a: Difference in FID between color morphs
      P1b: Difference in Concealment between color morphs
      
```{r}
summary(P1a <- lmer (FID ~ WCC + (1|Eartag), snoFIDcc))
plot(P1a)
qqnorm(resid(P1a))

summary(P1b <- lmer (conc ~ WCC + (1|Eartag), snoFIDcc))
plot(P1b)
qqnorm(resid(P1b))
```
No evidence that FID or Concealment differs between the color morphs.
  
     ~__________QUESTION 2___________~
 Is there evidence of behavioral plasticity to mitigate mismatch in this polymorphic hare population?
 
 H2: Mismatched hares will adjust their predator avoidance behavior to mitigate the risk of being mismatched.
    P2a: Mismatched hares will exhibit longer FIDs than camouflaged hares, leading to a positive relationship between % color contrast and FID.
    P2b: Mismatched hares will choose more concealed resting locations than camouflaged hares.
```{r}
summary(p2a <- lmer (FID ~ mm1m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(p2a)
  qqnorm(resid(p2a))

summary(p2aa <- lmer (FID ~ mm10m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(p2aa)
  qqnorm(resid(p2aa))

summary(p2b <- lmer (conc ~ mm1m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(p2b)
  qqnorm(resid(p2b))

summary(p2bb <- lmer (conc ~ mm10m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(p2bb)
  qqnorm(resid(p2bb))

summary(pcc2a <- lmer (FID ~ mm1m*WCC + (1|Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(pcc2a)
  qqnorm(resid(pcc2a))

summary(pcc2aa <- lmer (FID ~ mm10m*WCC + (1|Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(pcc2aa)
  qqnorm(resid(pcc2aa))

summary(pcc2b <- lmer (conc ~ mm1m*WCC + (1|Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(pcc2b)
  qqnorm(resid(pcc2b))

summary(pcc2bb <- lmer (conc ~ mm10m*WCC + (1|Eartag), snoFIDcc))
  plot(pcc2bb)
  qqnorm(resid(pcc2bb))
```

  Plot FIDs by Winter color morph
```{r fid wcc plot}
ggplot(data = FIDcc,
       mapping = aes(x = WCC, y = FID_m, fill=WCC)) +
  geom_boxplot(color="lightgray") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#CC9966", "snow")) + ylab("FID (m)") + xlab("Winter Color Morph") +
  ggtitle("Flight Initiation Distance (FID) by Winter Color Morph") +
  theme_dark()+
 theme(legend.position = "none")
        
```

  Plot FID against coat color contrast
```{r fid contrast plot}
print(mcontrastFID <- ggplot(data = snoFIDcc, aes(x = m_contrast, y = FID_m, color=P_White)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method=glm, linewidth=0.2, colour="yellow") + 
  scale_color_gradient("Hare % White", low="#CC9966", high= "#FFFFFFFF") +
  scale_shape_manual("Color Morph", values=c(16, 17)) +
  theme_dark() +
  ylab("FID (m)") + xlab("% contrast with ground color at 1m") + ggtitle("FID and Mismatch (1m) of Polymorphic Hares"))

print(tenmcontrastFID <- ggplot(data = snoFIDcc, aes(x = tenm_contrast, y = FID_m, color=P_White)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method=glm, linewidth=0.2, colour="yellow") + 
  scale_color_gradient("Hare % White", low="#CC9966", high= "#FFFFFFFF") +
  scale_shape_manual("Color Morph", values=c(16, 17))+
  theme_dark() +
  ylab("FID (m)") + xlab("% contrast with ground color at 10m") + ggtitle("FID and Mismatch (10m) of Polymorphic Hares"))

#This version with absolute value transformation on contrast
print(mm10FID <- ggplot(data = snoFIDcc, aes(x = mm10m, y = FID_m, color=P_White)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=WCC)) +
  geom_smooth(method=glm, linewidth=0.2, colour="yellow") + 
  scale_color_gradient("Hare % White", low="#CC9966", high= "#FFFFFFFF") +
  scale_shape_manual("Color Morph", values=c(16, 17))+
  theme_dark() +
  ylab("FID (m)") + xlab("% Color Mismatch at 10m") + ggtitle("FID and Mismatch (10m) of Polymorphic Hares"))
```

  Model selection - coat color and mismatch
```{r polymorphic fid model selection}
Poly.models <- list()
Poly.models[[01]] <- lmer (FID ~ (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[02]] <- lmer (FID ~ WCC + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[03]] <- lmer (FID ~ mm1m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[04]] <- lmer (FID ~ mm10m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[05]] <- lmer (FID ~ WCC*mm1m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[06]] <- lmer (FID ~ WCC*mm10m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[07]] <- lmer (FID ~ snow_1m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[08]] <- lmer (FID ~ snow_10m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[09]] <- lmer (FID ~ WCC*snow_1m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[10]] <- lmer (FID ~ WCC*snow_10m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[11]] <- lmer (FID ~ WCC*mm1m + snow_1m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)
Poly.models[[12]] <- lmer (FID ~ WCC*mm10m + snow_10m + (1 | Eartag), snoFIDcc, REML=FALSE)

   PModnames <- c("ETnull","wcc","1m","10m","wcc*1","wcc*10","1sno","10sno","wcc*1sno", "wcc*10sno", "wcc*1m_1sno", "wcc*10m_10sno") 
   
aicPoly<-aictab(cand.set = Poly.models, modnames = PModnames, sort = TRUE)
  aicPoly

  #Top model summary  
summary(Poly.models[[08]])
confint(Poly.models[[08]])

summary(Poly.models[[07]])

summary(Poly.models[[02]])
confint(Poly.models[[02]])

  #Warnings about scaling on interaction models
```

PLOT: Mismatch Time Series
```{r mismatch time series}

vFID <- filter(FID, WCC=="UNK")
vFID <- drop_na(FID, WCC, P_White, snow_10m, Date)

fiddates <- vFID$Date
dates <- as.Date(fiddates, format="%m/%d/%y")
con <- vFID$tenm_contrast
pw <- vFID$P_White
wcc <- vFID$WCC

timemm <- data.frame(dates, con, pw, wcc)

ggplot(timemm, aes(x = dates, y = con, group = wcc, color = pw)) + 
     theme_dark() +
     geom_line() + 
     geom_point(size=.7) +
      scale_color_gradient("Hare % White", low="#CC9966", high= "#FFFFFFFF") + 
       xlab("Date") + ylab("% Coat Color Mismatch") + ggtitle("Observed Hare Coat Color Mismatch Time Series") +
     scale_x_date(breaks = as.Date(c("2020-11-15", "2021-5-15", "2021-11-15", "2022-5-15", "2022-11-15")), labels = c("Nov 2020", "May 2021", "Nov 2021", "May 2022", "Nov 2022"))
      
```
